brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a pest control visit to resolve an ant problem at my property.
facts: I own a residential duplex with two separate units.
I have noticed ant activity in the ground-floor unit.
My property address is 742 Evergreen Terrace.
preferences: I prefer having both units inspected and treated during the same visit.
I prefer a morning appointment window if one is available.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, up to the not-to-exceed figure they quote

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Automated Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling ProGuard Pest Control. For service scheduling, press 1. For billing, press 2.

script.label: Agent Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling ProGuard Pest Control service scheduling. My name is Derek, how can I help you today?

script.label: Pest Type Inquiry
script.text: I can certainly help you set up an appointment for that. What type of pest activity are you noticing?

script.label: Address Request
script.text: Got it. May I have the service address so I can check technician availability in your area?

script.label: Second Unit Inquiry
script.text: Looking up that address, our records show this is a multi-family property. Would you like us to include the second unit in this treatment as well?

script.label: Price Quote
script.text: For that service, the total price comes out to exactly 160 dollars.

script.label: Arrival Window Offer
script.text: Our next available appointment is this Thursday between 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

script.label: Contact Information Request
script.text: Could I please get your full name and primary phone number to lock that time in?

script.label: Booking Confirmation
script.text: You are all scheduled for Thursday between 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Our technician will call you 30 minutes before arrival.

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
